source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 22ης Ιουνίου — «Άγιος Πομπιανός»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 22 Ιουνίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing, and gives no year. The corpus keeps no other man of this name; the two Pompeii it holds are companions of Terentius and one of the Ten of Crete, and neither is on this day or drowned. The same day's listing gives Γαλατίων the identical manner of death, and the corpus's `galaction-the-martyr-22-june` is that man, a separate entry on the same page. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence.
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue on pravoslavno.rs for the corresponding Julian day (1 October 2026).
